definition: A link is a documented shared treatment, computation, benchmark or geometry. For the sensitivity calculation, connect included works with a recorded link; retain a work with no known link as its own group. Some links are deliberately broad. Separate groups have not been established to be statistically independent. Named benchmarks and references for all remaining tests are in source_dispositions.json.
